```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Objective
The objective of this model is to identify regions of small intestinal mucosa 
in tissue fragments and classif them based on orientation.

This is a rule-based model where the parameters were set by trying different values and inspecting
resulting polygons in QuPath

## Parameters
- *min_area_1000_um*: Small intestinal mucosa polygons under this size are filtered out before being assigned names, default is 100 (100,000 um2)
- *high_conf_lim*: Mucosal layers under this confidence levels are not considered when classifying
mucosa polygons as small intestinal mucosa or not (but are still used for outlining the small intestinal mucosal polygons, and for calculating percentages). Default is 100 %.
- *adequate_th*: The percentages of villi, crypts, portion of circumference of villi or crypts overlapping with the circumference of the others needs all to be above this to be considered adequate. Default is 30 %.
- *marginal_th*: The percentages of villi, crypts, portion of circumference of villi or crypts overlapping with the circumference of the others needs all to be above this (but not all to be above the adequate th to be considered marginal. If any is under it is inadequate.  Default is 10%.



## Input
- *subset_<subset_name>.json* (fe_si_images/process_subset/output/process_subset/)
A list of all images in the set with associated metadata
- *fragment_list* use either of these
  - *fragment_metadata_<subset_name.json* (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/)
  Automatically classified as duplicate or not (can contain errors) 
   - *fragment_metadata_<subset_name.json* (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/)
  Automatically classified as duplicate or not (can contain errors) 
  - *corrected_fragments_<subset_name>.json* (fe_si_models/fragments/output/validate_fragments/)
  Manually corrected erroneous duplicate classification (for human-in-the-loop approach)
- *<image_name>_<fragment_name>_fragments.geojson* (fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/)
- *<image_name>_<fragment_name>_layers.geojson* (fe_si_models/combos/output/combos/)


## Output
- *<image_name>_<fragment_name>_<mucosa_name>_si_mucosa.geojson* (fe_si_models/si_mucosa/output/si_mucosa/)
- *template_si_mucosa_<subset_name>.xlsx* (fe_si_models/si_mucosa/output/si_mucosa/)
- *si_mucosa_metadata_<subset_name>.json* (fe_si_models/si_mucosa/output/si_mucosa/)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(jsonlite)
library(writexl)
library(readxl)

to_box <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/"

process_si_mucosa <- function(subset, 
                              fragment_list, 
                              fragments_dir, 
                              combos_dir, 
                              output_dir, 
                              min_area_1000_um2 = 100,
                              high_conf_limit = 100,
                              adequate_th = 30,
                              marginal_th = 10){
  
  image_names <- unique(fragment_list$image_name)
  image_fragment_names <- paste(fragment_list$image_name, fragment_list$fragment_name, sep = "_")
  
  #Filter on available layers file (large files are difficult to download)
  layer_files <- list.files(combos_dir)
  matching_image_fragment_names <- image_fragment_names[
    sapply(image_fragment_names, function(name) any(startsWith(layer_files, name)))
  ]
  
  all_templates <- NULL
  
  for (image_fragment in matching_image_fragment_names){
    
    #Isolate image name and fragment name from image_fragment_name
    split_matrix <- str_split_fixed(image_fragment, "_", 2)
    img <- split_matrix[, 1]
    frag <- split_matrix[, 2]
    
    #Isolate metadata from subset
    image_metadata <- subset %>% filter(image_name == img)
    pixel_area_um2 <- image_metadata$pixel_area_um2
    pixel_length_um <- image_metadata$pixel_length_um
    
    #Read in and process layers 
    layer_path <- paste0(combos_dir, image_fragment, "_layers.geojson")
    layers <- st_read(layer_path, quiet = TRUE) %>% st_set_crs(0)
    
    #Handle cases with no layers (no recognized villi or crypts of any confidence)
    
    if (nrow(layers) == 0) {
      fragment_path <- paste0(fragments_dir, img, "_fragments.geojson")
      si_mucosa_md <- st_read(fragment_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
        st_set_crs(0) %>%
        filter(name == frag) %>%
        rename(fragment_name = name) %>%
        mutate(mucosa_name = "00",
               name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, sep = "_"),
               classification = "no_si_mucosa",
               area_1000_um2 = fragment_area_um2 / 1000,
               pct_villi = 0,
               pct_crypts = 0,
               pct_shared_border_villi = NA,
               pct_shared_border_crypts = NA) %>%
        select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, area_1000_um2,pct_villi, pct_crypts, pct_shared_border_villi, pct_shared_border_crypts, geometry)
      
       #st_write(si_mucosa_md, paste0(output_dir, si_mucosa_md$name, "_si_mucosa.geojson"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
       
        all_templates <- bind_rows(all_templates, st_drop_geometry(si_mucosa_md))
        
        next
    }
    
    #Unite the different layers to si_mucosa polygons (may vary in number per fragment)
    si_mucosa <- layers %>%
      group_by(image_name, fragment_name, objectType, isLocked) %>%
      summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%
      st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(classification = "si_mucosa",
             area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
             area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
             area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000) %>%
      filter(area_1000_um2 > min_area_1000_um2) %>%
      mutate(mucosa_name = str_pad(rank(-area_px2, ties.method = "first"), width = 2, pad = "0"),
             name = paste(img, frag, mucosa_name, sep = "_")) %>%
      select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name, classification, area_1000_um2) %>%
      arrange(name)
  
    #Unite each class of layers to calculate percentages of each and intersection
    
    #Only high confidence layers are used to decide if small intestine or not
    layers_high_conf_united <- layers %>%
      mutate(confidence_percentage = round(confidence_percentage)) %>%
      filter(confidence_percentage == high_conf_limit) %>%
      group_by(image_name, fragment_name, objectType, isLocked, classification) %>%
      summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")
    
    villi_high_conf <- layers_high_conf_united %>% filter(classification == "villi")
    crypts_high_conf <- layers_high_conf_united %>% filter(classification == "crypts")
    
    #Layers of all confidence levels are used for calculating percentages used for orientation
    layers_all_conf_united <- layers %>%
      group_by(image_name, fragment_name, objectType, isLocked, classification) %>%
      summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop")
    
    villi <- layers_all_conf_united %>% filter(classification == "villi")
    crypts <- layers_all_conf_united %>% filter(classification == "crypts")
    
    #Process by individual mucosa polygons within fragments
    
     for (muc_part in si_mucosa$mucosa_name) {
       
       si_mucosa_part <- si_mucosa %>% filter(mucosa_name == muc_part)
       mucosa_geom <- si_mucosa_part %>% select(name, geometry)
       
       villi_high <- st_intersection(villi_high_conf, mucosa_geom) %>%
        mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
               area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
               area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000,
               circumference_px = st_length(st_boundary(geometry)))
       
        crypts_high <- st_intersection(crypts_high_conf, mucosa_geom) %>%
        mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
               area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
               area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000,
               circumference_px = st_length(st_boundary(geometry)))
        
        villi_all_conf <- st_intersection(villi, mucosa_geom) %>%
        mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
               area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
               area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000,
               circumference_px = st_length(st_boundary(geometry)))
        
        crypts_all_conf <- st_intersection(crypts, mucosa_geom) %>%
        mutate(area_px2 = st_area(geometry),
               area_um2 = area_px2 * pixel_area_um2,
               area_1000_um2 = area_um2 / 1000,
               circumference_px = st_length(st_boundary(geometry)))
        
        #Classify orientation
        if (nrow(villi_high) == 0 && nrow(crypts_high) == 0) {
        si_mucosa_md <- si_mucosa_part %>%
          mutate(classification = "no_si_mucosa",
                 pct_villi = 0, pct_crypts = 0,
                 pct_shared_border_villi = NA,
                 pct_shared_border_crypts = NA)
        } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) == 0 && nrow(crypts_all_conf) != 0) {
        si_mucosa_md <- si_mucosa_part %>%
          mutate(classification = "inadequate_orientation",
                 pct_villi = 0, pct_crypts = 100,
                 pct_shared_border_villi = NA,
                 pct_shared_border_crypts = NA)
        } else if (nrow(villi_all_conf) != 0 && nrow(crypts_all_conf) == 0) {
        si_mucosa_md <- si_mucosa_part %>%
          mutate(classification = "inadequate_orientation",
                 pct_villi = 100, pct_crypts = 0,
                 pct_shared_border_villi = NA,
                 pct_shared_border_crypts = NA)
        } else {
        shared_border <- st_intersection(st_boundary(villi_all_conf), st_boundary(crypts_all_conf))
        
        shared_len <- st_length(shared_border)
        
        villi_part <- villi_all_conf %>%
          mutate(pct_shared_border = (shared_len / circumference_px) * 100)
        
        crypts_part <- crypts_all_conf %>%
          mutate(pct_shared_border = (shared_len / circumference_px) * 100)
        
        si_mucosa_md <- si_mucosa_part %>%
          mutate(pct_villi = (villi_part$area_1000_um2 / area_1000_um2) * 100,
                 pct_crypts = (crypts_part$area_1000_um2 / area_1000_um2) * 100,
                 pct_shared_border_villi = villi_part$pct_shared_border,
                 pct_shared_border_crypts = crypts_part$pct_shared_border,
                 classification = case_when(
                   pct_villi > adequate_th & pct_crypts > adequate_th &
                     pct_shared_border_villi > adequate_th & pct_shared_border_crypts > adequate_th ~ "adequate_orientation",
                   pct_villi > marginal_th & pct_crypts > marginal_th &
                     pct_shared_border_villi > marginal_th & pct_shared_border_crypts > marginal_th ~ "marginal_orientation",
                   pct_villi <= marginal_th | pct_crypts <= marginal_th |
                     pct_shared_border_villi <= marginal_th | pct_shared_border_crypts <= marginal_th ~ "inadequate_orientation",
                   TRUE ~ NA_character_
                 ))
        }
        
        #st_write(si_mucosa_md, paste0(output_dir, si_mucosa_md$name, "_si_mucosa.geojson"), quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
        
        all_templates <- bind_rows(all_templates, st_drop_geometry(si_mucosa_md))
     }
  }
  
   return(all_templates)
  
}
```

#### Process subset_labl_2020_tuning

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
subset <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_labl_2020_tuning.json")

fragment_list <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/fragments/output/validate_fragments/corrected_fragments_labl_2020_tuning.json") %>%
  filter(classification == "included_fragment")

fragment_dir <- paste0(to_box, "Projects/fe_si_models/fragments/output/fragments/")
combos_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/combos/output/combos/"
output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/si_mucosa/output/si_mucosa/"

min_area_1000_um2 <- 100
high_conf_limit <- 100
adequate_th <- 30
marginal_th <-  10

template_si_mucosa_labl_2020_tuning <- process_si_mucosa(subset, fragment_list, fragment_dir, combos_dir, output_dir)

write_xlsx(template_si_mucosa_labl_2020_tuning, paste0(output_dir, "template_si_mucosa_labl_2020_tuning.xlsx"))

write_json(template_si_mucosa_labl_2020_tuning, paste0(output_dir, "template_si_mucosa_labl_2020_tuning.json"))
```
